title: alchemilla vulgaris subsp. obtusa
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris subsp. obtusa, commonly known as the Bear's Foot or Lady's Mantle, is a flowering plant species in the family Rosaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and calm irritated skin, reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla vulgaris subsp. obtusa include its astringent, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, making it a popular ingredient in skincare products and herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may help to protect against oxidative stress and cell damage.
